description: A bearded man in a rough grey tunic kneels in a dim room, head bowed, pressing a reed stylus into a small clay tablet cupped in his left hand. Baskets of grain sit beside him, with a large jar and a second basket behind, and a mat on the right holds rows of finished tablets covered in small wedge-like marks. Loose grain and wheat ears lie on the floor. The image is an oil-painting style, full bleed, with no frame or visible text other than the tablet marks.
